summary: Rankings were flat to slightly down this week: still page 1 only for 'kosher catering Dallas' (~#10), and the long-tail 'kosher Shabbat meal delivery Dallas order online' slipped from roughly #3 to #5. The bigger problem is that none of last week's four high-priority fixes shipped — the Dallas Kosher catering listing still links to thehungryroostertx.com/page/catering, a URL that 404s, and inspecting that page revealed something worse: every other caterer there gets a plain crawlable website URL in their write-up while THR gets only the broken button. Meanwhile Meat Point keeps compounding with its new kosher sushi concept and a Friday Shabbat menu, ranking on three target terms where The Hungry Rooster ranks on none.
